instructions: Extract the flight search from the user's message. STATE.today is today's date and weekday. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD: resolve relative dates (amanhã, sexta, semana que vem) against today; a date without a year is its next occurrence from today; a return given as a duration counts from the departure. Use null when the message has no specific day (only a month, or nothing). adults counts the adults traveling, including the user (default 1). childrenAges lists the ages of children under 18; a baby under 1 year is 0. cabinClass is ECONOMY unless the message asks for another. Keep place names as the user wrote them; null when absent.
